sources.title: Solar Pro 4 model specifications and versions
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Names Solar Pro 4 and snapshot solar-pro4-260806, released August 6, 2026; gives 512K context, English/Korean/Japanese text use, reasoning and tool calling. The parameter row still explicitly says Undisclosed parameters; no total or active count or named base-model lineage is provided.

sources.title: Upstage Console changelog
sources.evidence: August 6 entry announces solar-pro4 available. August 11 entry starts paid usage after the free period ended August 10, separating release from later billing and launch publicity.

sources.title: Upstage AI unveils Solar Pro 4
sources.evidence: August 20 press release explicitly describes Solar Pro 4 as a closed commercial LLM and identifies Upstage as its developer.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 launch article
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Describes API access, 512K context, optional reasoning effort, document and coding tasks, tool calling and OfficeVerse training. Says OfficeVerse is a training-task pipeline used since Solar Open 2 and compares the two products, but never identifies Solar Pro 4 as a fine-tune or post-trained version of Solar Open 2, nor publishes Pro 4 total/active parameters or architecture.

sources.title: Responses API reference
sources.evidence: Explicitly supports solar-pro4 and solar-pro4-260806, rejects non-text input parts, produces text, and documents reasoning and function tools.

sources.title: Generative model comparison
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The comparison table explicitly labels Solar Pro 4 parameters Undisclosed, alongside separately disclosed Mini 4 35B / 3B active, Pro 2 31B and Mini 10.7B. It provides no active count or architecture for Pro 4.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 tokenizer model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Tokenizer-only repository specifies a 196,608-token vocabulary and explicitly contains no model weights or chat template. It provides no model parameter count or base-model lineage. Its tokenizer license does not establish a license for the closed model.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report, version 2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Solar Open 2 report v2 discloses nominal 250B total and 15B active parameters and hybrid MoE architecture for Solar Open 2. A full-text search finds no Pro 4 mention. Its explicit weight-transfer discussion concerns Solar Open 1 to Solar Open 2, not Solar Pro 4, so it does not establish inheritance of the published counts.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4 launch article
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. October 1 Mini 4 release explicitly states 35B total and 3B active parameters and MoE structure, and says Mini 4 was pretrained from the ground up. The Pro 4 mention is a related-post link, not a Pro 4 size or architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 on aib.vote: final report and Solar Pro 4 testing announcement
sources.evidence: An unaffiliated community user says Solar Pro 4 became available for testing on aib.vote that day. HF API dates the unedited post August 3, 2026. It supplies no exact snapshot identity or confirmation from Upstage.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 hosted model specifications
sources.evidence: Hosted provider page gives a 524,288-token context and 131,072-token output ceiling; live models API confirms text-to-text. Its August 10 listing date is later than the explicit Upstage release.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4 preview announcement and comparison with Solar Pro 4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 after an initial 403. September 14 report of CEO Sung Kim's Facebook Mini 4 preview announcement calls Solar Pro 4 250B. The article does not link an original statement establishing that Pro 4 count. Its Upstage-supplied graphic, separately inspected in s16, discloses only Mini 4 35B total / 3B active and compares performance with Pro 4. The secondary 250B claim remains a lead without primary confirmation.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4: official Korean launch article
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Korean launch text explains that the OfficeVerse task-synthesis pipeline was developed starting with Solar Open 2 and used to train and validate the model. It contrasts Solar Open 2 and Pro 4 as different products and publishes performance comparisons, but provides no Pro 4 parameter count and no explicit base-weight or unchanged-architecture lineage. Shared training data/pipeline is insufficient to inherit Open 2 counts.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 official model card
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Official card identifies Solar Open 2 as a 250B-A15B hybrid-attention MoE. Full-page search finds no Pro 4 mention, so this nominal size is supported for Open 2 but no base-model relationship permits applying it to Pro 4.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report version history and abstract
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Latest listed revision remains v2, July 24, 2026. Abstract explicitly describes initializing Solar Open 2 from Solar Open 1 while transferring a 5.69B shared skeleton and learning other parameters through full pretraining. This is explicit lineage for Open 2 only; it supplies no Pro 4 lineage or count and no newer report revision resolves that gap.

sources.title: Upstage Solar Mini 4 private-beta graphic reproduced by AI Times
sources.evidence: Visually inspected October 27, 2026. Upstage-branded artwork credited to Upstage by s12 says Mini 4 has 35B total / 3B active parameters and performance approaching Solar Pro 4. No 250B value or other Pro 4 total/active count appears in the artwork. It therefore does not corroborate the separate Pro 4 250B assertion in the article text.

name.note: Exact official product name; solar-pro4 aliases solar-pro4-260806.

developer.note: Official documentation and the developer announcement identify Upstage.

family.note: Normalized catalog family for the Solar Pro series; the official article compares Pro 4 with Pro 3.

release_date.note: Retain the explicit developer release date, including initial free API access. August 11 is paid usage and launch publicity. The earlier August 3 aib.vote post is an unaffiliated testing claim without a version identifier or developer corroboration, so it remains an unresolved preview lead rather than overriding the documented release.

open_weights.note: Upstage explicitly calls this a closed commercial model and contrasts it with open-weight Solar Open 2. A released tokenizer is not a weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification supported by the closed commercial API offering; the Upstage Solar License attached to tokenizer files is not a model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit retains null because current exact-model Upstage specs and comparison explicitly mark parameters undisclosed. Reopened the English/Korean launch articles, tokenizer card, later Mini 4 release, latest Open 2 report/card, and searched English/Korean parameter, 250B and fine-tune/post-training lineage claims. No developer-published nominal Pro 4 size or explicit base-weight lineage was found. Shared OfficeVerse training-task generation does not identify a base model. AI Times calls Pro 4 250B, but the attached Upstage artwork supplies only Mini 4 counts and no primary confirmation of the Pro 4 value was found. A nominal count would be accepted without a tensor census; the unresolved issue is attribution and model identity, not precision.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked active parameters separately on October 27. No exact-model developer source provides a Pro 4 active count or a structurally unchanged base-model relationship. Open 2's published nominal 15B active and Mini 4's 3B active refer to those named models only. The shared OfficeVerse pipeline and performance comparisons do not establish weight or architecture inheritance, and the secondary Pro 4 250B claim supplies no active count. Keep null; no component or phase count is supported.

architecture.note: Official model documentation and training discussion do not disclose Pro 4 network architecture. The Open 2 report has no Pro 4 reference; neither MoE nor dense classification is inferred from related models.

context_window.note: Upstage states 512K; the serving provider explicitly resolves this to 524,288 tokens. The separate 128K output ceiling is not the context window. Direct unauthenticated access to Upstage model metadata returned 401, so that endpoint was not used as evidence.

modalities.note: Exact-model Responses API permits text inputs and text outputs and rejects non-text input parts. Document workflows do not imply native image input.

reasoning.note: Official docs support configurable reasoning effort and reasoning output; it may be disabled by default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model docs explicitly support function tools and tool selection.

description.value: Text model for document analysis, coding and tool-using workflows, with optional reasoning and a 512K-token context window.
description.note: Replaces promotional flagship wording with documented task coverage and capabilities, without asserting undisclosed architecture or size.

patch.description: Text model for document analysis, coding and tool-using workflows, with optional reasoning and a 512K-token context window.

patch.notes: Upstage documents release on August 6, 2026; paid API usage began August 11. An unaffiliated August 3 testing announcement does not identify the served snapshot. October 27 parameter re-audit: exact-model docs still explicitly withhold total size, and no active count is published. English/Korean launch articles share the OfficeVerse training-task pipeline with Solar Open 2 but do not establish base-weight lineage, so Open 2's nominal 250B/15B cannot be inherited. AI Times' Pro 4 250B claim remains unconfirmed by primary material; its Upstage-supplied image gives only Mini 4 35B/3B. Architecture remains undisclosed. The tokenizer license does not apply to the closed model weights.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts, with explicit null patches. Reopened exact-model documentation, English/Korean launch articles, tokenizer card, Mini 4 announcement and latest Open 2 report/card; searched English/Korean nominal-size and lineage claims. Current specs explicitly withhold size. The shared OfficeVerse pipeline is not explicit base-weight lineage, and the Upstage graphic attached to the secondary 250B claim gives only Mini 4 counts. No published nominal Pro 4 count or supported inheritance was found. Original non-parameter assessments are preserved.
